# Trump to visit Chicago for PGA's President's Cup in September

Jeramie  Bizzle

Updated on: August 29, 2026 / 5:05 PM CDT
/ CBS Chicago

President Trump will be making a visit to Chicago next month for the PGA's Presidents Cup, he announced on Saturday.

The event will be held at the Medinah Country Club from Sept. 22-27. [...] Pritzker and Mayor Brandon Johnson had not commented on Mr. Trump's planned visit as of Saturday afternoon.
